scenicChapters.title: Hanno fuel gate → Okutama lake road
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 39 km. 430 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall. A steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Okutama lake road → Kazahari pass road
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 6.9%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.

scenicChapters.title: Kazahari pass road → Akiruno food stop
scenicChapters.narrative: 40 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

sections.advice: Fukushima → Jododaira is 25 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.

Tsuchiyu Pass → Inawashiro drops about 1240 m over 22 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Bandai-Azuma Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: For 44 km this is Bandai-Azuma Skyline, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Bandai-Azuma Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: First and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding. The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 17.5%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Bandai-Azuma Skyline
scenicChapters.narrative: 1240 m come off over 40 km at around 5.5%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it — brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 7.3%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.

scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 65 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
